claimText:
Reorganize the `ela30-1-modern-drama` Writing Studio activity.

Acceptance boundary:
- Keep the existing ELA 30-1 Streetcar course shell and styling.
- Move the existing critical response question activity under the Text Knowledge tab as grouped question practice.
- Replace the Thesis Control tab with the downloaded `C:\Users\dean.guedo\Downloads\thesis_builder_activity.tsx` activity, converted into static Brightspace-friendly HTML/JavaScript.
- Track both injected sources in project metadata.
- Rebuild and verify `projects/ela30-1-modern-drama/workspace/index.html`.

STAX acknowledgement
STAX_ACK turn_2026-06-08T17-00-19-929Z_ba7d 4133ed61 dac77546

Objective
Redesign the Forensics Module 1 static package plan so it keeps the stripped/static Google-site-ready behavior while matching the Forensic Studies 25 Option Two shell and visual language.

Files changed
- .stax/codex-report.md

Tests added
- None.

Commands run
- Read STAX contract/status/next prompt and relevant Forensics Option Two/static generator files in this turn.

Command output summary with exit codes
- Prior reads completed with exit code 0. No validation command was run because implementation is blocked pending user approval by the brainstorming/design gate.

What is verified
- Option Two source shell and styling exist under projects/forensicstudiesoption2/workspace/.
- Current static generator is scripts/build-forensics-module1-static.ts.
- Current generator already targets Module 1 static stripping behavior but does not use the Option Two shell.

What is weak/provisional
- STAX status remains stale/reject for an unrelated prior ELA task, not this Forensics task.
- No visual implementation has been made yet.

What is unverified
- Final rebuilt ZIP, local preview, residue checks, and visual parity are unverified until implementation is approved and completed.

Risks
- Copying the full Option Two runtime directly would reintroduce progress/localStorage/locking/full-course assumptions, so the safer plan is to copy the visual shell/classes and write a minimal static Module 1 runtime.

One next action
- Get user approval for the Option Two static-clone approach, then edit the generator and rebuild the package.
